method: Source, generated CXX bridge, optimized Rust assembly/LLVM IR and configured Clang object disassembly; no performance timing.
observations: Dotted conversion and validation share safe allocation-free label scanning; C++ allocates only the final returned vector.

URL canonicalization writes directly into the eventual C++ std::string. Rust controls BROKEN fallback via callback; no Rust Vec or per-byte Vec push transport remains.
Length readers and conversion functions return scalar validity/length/consumption metadata.
DomainNameLess object disassembly ends in jmp net_dns_names_less, with no byte-span conversion calls or CXX Slice temporaries in this C++ adapter.

limits: These are structural observations, not measurements of elapsed time, allocation counts, bridge overhead or achieved speedups. Native object flags can differ from the final configured target.
